hero.bio:
I am a technology, program management and business transformation professional with nearly 33 years of experience across military and corporate environments.

My career began in technology and engineering with the Pakistan Air Force, where I developed a strong foundation in electronics, communications, technical operations and team leadership. Moving into the corporate sector with Huawei, my career progressively evolved from technical delivery into project and program management, PMO, managed services, customer engagement and leadership responsibilities.

Over time, my focus expanded beyond delivering individual projects to leading teams, improving delivery functions and supporting the transition and transformation of departments and business operations. Since 2023, my experience in Saudi Arabia has further broadened across power distribution, utility services and digital consultancy.

Today, my professional focus is on bringing together technology, people, processes and business priorities to enable successful transformation and sustainable delivery—while keeping client success, stakeholder expectations and business outcomes at the centre.

I am PMP and ITIL certified and believe in practical leadership, accountability, clear communication and continuous improvement.

about.quote: I bring dedication to achieve the business goals by utilizing my in-depth knowledge and 30+ years' experience in program management of infrastructure, telecom and digital consultancy sectors along with business acumen for strategic planning, forecasting, budgeting and analysis, operational excellence, resource planning, stakeholder management, pre-sales and sales.
paragraphs: In the last 15+ years, I have delivered large-scale and high-value infrastructure projects for Saudi Electricity Company, municipalities across KSA, and rollout, transformation, swap, and merger projects for telecom operators in the Middle East including Etisalat, Mobily, China Mobile, and Veon Group.

More recently, I have provided PMO functional oversight, governance, and delivery assurance for digital governance and transformation consultancy programs for Saudi organizations including ZATCA, HRDA, SEC, TGA, NDMO, SDAIA, and GSTAT.
